en-US.promotionalText: Turn ideas into interactive replies and research into project files. Bring your models to Palmi on iPhone and iPad, and keep your work and stories moving.
en-US.description:
Palmi brings AI conversations and a practical workspace to iPhone and iPad. Connect your chosen model service to ask questions, work on your writing, understand images, research a topic, or analyze data and save the results as files.

Answers you can explore
Try adjustable charts, calculators, animations, or small games inside a reply. Text, images, and interactive content stay together in the conversation so you can compare options and try out an idea.

Keep your work in projects
Use Professional mode to organize conversations, source material, and results in projects. Follow task progress, inspect tool activity, and add instructions as work continues. Browse folders, preview files, and share the results.

Research with sources in view
Search the web, read pages and supported documents, follow leads, and turn findings into answers and files. Browser control is available in beta in Professional mode: direct the built-in browser in everyday language, view multiple pages, and take over for sign-in or verification.

Work with data on your device
Run local Python calculations and data processing, recognize text in images, and read supported PDF, Office, and iWork documents. Keep source material, intermediate files, and results in your project workspace.

Your models and methods
Connect compatible model services, organize models into groups, choose a default, and switch models in a conversation. Tools such as image generation can use a separately selected model. Import skills to reuse your methods across the app or in a specific project.

Characters and ongoing stories
Bionic mode supports custom fictional characters, conversations, and memories. The free version includes the built-in Palmi character and up to two custom characters. A one-time Bionic Pro purchase raises the custom-character limit to 99 and unlocks memory details, editing, links to source messages, diary reading, and more. Characters, stories, and generated images are fictional.

Bring a model service
You need to configure a compatible model service to get started. Palmi does not include third-party model credits. Available models, web search, image features, and their costs depend on the services you choose. Bionic Pro does not include model credits.

Conversations, project files, and task state are stored on your device by default. Content needed for a request goes directly to your configured model or search service, subject to that service's terms and privacy policy. Access to device data follows system permissions and app tool settings. iOS manages background execution time.
en-US.whatsNew:
Palmi 26.11 brings a fresh conversation and workspace experience.

• Replies you can interact with: Explore charts, calculators, animations, and small games alongside text and images in a conversation.
• Browser control, in beta: Give the built-in browser a task in Professional mode, view multiple pages, and take over whenever you need to.
• A clearer interface: Open straight into a chat. A new sidebar brings together conversations, files, skills, and settings.
• A new model library: Organize models into groups, choose a default, switch models in a conversation, and select suitable models for individual tools.
• A smoother workspace: Browse project folders, preview and share results, and answer follow-up questions without leaving your current screen in Palmi.
• Bionic conversation improvements: Better replies, read status, unread reminders, and background progress.
• Added German, Swedish, Arabic, Turkish, Indonesian, and French.

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 在 Palmi，把想法聊成可交互的回答，把资料整理成项目成果。接入你喜欢的模型，在 iPhone 和 iPad 上研究、计算、管理文件，也与虚拟角色延续故事。
zh-Hans.description:
Palmi 是 iPhone 和 iPad 上的 AI 对话与工作空间。接入你选择的模型服务，用它回答日常问题、协助写作、理解图片，也可以研究资料、计算数据，把结果保存为文件。

回答，也可以动手试
在回复中探索可调图表、计算器、动画或小型游戏。文字、图片与可交互内容放在同一段对话里，帮助你理解问题、比较方案，试一试自己的想法。

把资料和成果放进项目
在专业模式中，把会话、输入资料和成果放进项目。查看任务进度、工具活动和记录，随时补充要求。浏览文件夹，预览与分享文件，把工作结果带走。

查资料，看到来源
搜索网页，阅读页面与支持的文档，跟进线索，把资料整理成回答和文件。专业模式提供浏览器操控测试版：用自然语言指挥内置浏览器，查看多个页面，在需要登录或验证时亲自接手。

在设备上处理资料
运行本地 Python 计算与数据处理，识别图片文字，读取支持的 PDF、Office 和 iWork 文档。原始资料、中间文件和成果可以保存在项目工作区中。

选择自己的模型与方法
连接兼容的模型服务，按组管理模型，选择默认模型，并在对话中切换。图片生成等工具也可以单独选择适用的模型。导入技能，将常用方法用于全局或指定项目。

与虚拟角色延续故事
仿生模式支持自定义角色设定、对话与记忆。基础版含内置 Palmi 角色，最多可保留两个自定义角色。一次性购买仿生 Pro 后，自定义角色上限提升至 99 个，并解锁记忆详情、编辑、来源消息跳转和日记阅读等功能。角色、故事与生成图片均为虚构内容。

使用前请准备模型服务
开始使用前，你需要自行配置兼容的模型服务。Palmi 不包含第三方模型额度；模型、联网搜索和图像能力的可用性及费用取决于所选服务。仿生 Pro 不包含模型额度。

对话、项目文件与任务状态默认保存在设备上。请求所需内容直接发送至你配置的模型或搜索服务，并适用相应服务的条款与隐私政策。设备数据访问由系统权限和应用工具设置控制。后台任务的运行时间由 iOS 管理。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
Palmi 26.11，带来全新的对话与工作体验。

• 让回答动起来：图表、计算器、动画和小型游戏可直接出现在回复中，文字、图片与可交互内容连贯呈现。
• 浏览器操控测试版：在专业模式中用自然语言指挥内置浏览器，同时查看多个页面，随时亲自接手。
• 更清晰的界面：打开即可聊天，全新侧栏集中收纳会话、文件、技能与设置。
• 新的模型库：按组管理模型、设定默认项，在会话中选择模型，并为不同工具配置适合的模型。
• 更顺手的工作区：集中浏览项目文件，展开文件夹、预览和分享成果；需要你做决定时，可直接在当前界面回答。
• 更连贯的仿生对话：优化角色回复、已读状态、未读提醒和后台进度。
• 新增德语、瑞典语、阿拉伯语、土耳其语、印尼语和法语。
